answer:
Query: Show the coal flow from wagon or track hopper to boiler bunker and include relevant diagrams.

Key course evidence:
- What is the fundamental principle of a Track Hopper? A The wagon is physically rotated to empty coal B Bottom doors open and coal falls by gravity into pit below C A vacuum system draws coal out of the wagon D Hydraulic rams tilt the wagon sideways [What is the fundamental principle of a Track Hopper?, concept: what-is-the-fundamental-principle-of-a-track-hopper]
- The Track Hopper area looks quiet between unloadings. Is it safe to approach the grizzly edge? A Yes — if no wagon is on the track, it is safe B Yes — the feeder stops automatically between unloading cycles C No — feeder may still run, arch could collapse, bars may be wet, dust may be present underground D Yes, but only briefly and with both hands free [The Track Hopper area looks quiet between unloadings. Is it safe to approach the grizzly edge?, concept: the-track-hopper-area-looks-quiet-between-unloadings-is-it-safe-to-approach-the-grizzly-edge]
- Wagon Tippler से Belt Conveyor तक का Flow Step | Equipment | Function ; 1 | Wagon Tippler / Track Hopper | Coal wagon को empty करता है — hopper में dump ; 2 | Hopper + Vibratory/Apron Feeder | Controlled rate पर coal को Belt No. 1 पर feed करता है ; 3 | Belt Conveyor No. 1 (BC-1) | Coal को Crusher House तक ले जाती है ; 4 | Crusher House | Coal को ≤50 mm तक crush करता है ; 5 | CHP Conveyors | Crushed coal को Coal Yard / Bunkers तक पहुँचाती हैं ; 6 | Bunker → Mill → Boiler | Generation cycle शुरू होती है [Wagon Tippler से Belt Conveyor तक का Flow, concept: wagon-tippler-belt-conveyor-flow]
- System Flow Integration – Coal का पूरा सफर Coal का सफर एक relay race की तरह है — हर stage अगली stage को handoff करती है। एक भी stage fail हुई तो पूरी race रुक जाती है। Belt conveyor system अकेले काम नहीं करता — यह एक बड़े coal handling sequence का हिस्सा है। Wagon tippler से boiler तक हर step एक specific function है जो अगले step पर निर्भर करती है। यह chain समझना ज़रूरी है। ① Railway Wagon Coal loaded BOX-N wagons railway tracks पर आते हैं ⚠ Surge loading risk ② Wagon Tippler Wagon को rotate/tilt करके coal को dump करता है ⚠ High dust generation ③ Track Hopper Coal को temporarily store करता है ⚠ Overflow risk ④ Feeder Coal की rate control करके belt पर डालता है ⚠ Overfeeding risk ⑤ Belt Conveyor BC-1 Coal को aage carry ⚠ Drift, overload risk ⑥ Transfer Tower BC-1 से BC-2 पर coal ⚠ HIGHEST RISK ZONE ⑦ Belt Conveyor BC-2 Bunker तक carry ⚠ Same risks ⑧ Coal Bunker 8–12 hrs buffer storage ⚠ Overflow / starvation ⑨ Pulveriser Coal को powder बनाता है → Boiler में जाती है ✓ Electricity generatio... [System Flow Integration – Coal का पूरा सफर, concept: system-flow-integration-coal]
- The complete coal journey 1 Coal Wagon Bottom doors open over track hopper 2 Track Hopper Pit Coal falls by gravity into underground cavity 3 Grizzly Screen Steel bars filter out oversized material 4 Feeder System Extracts coal at controlled, steady rate 5 Belt Conveyor Carries coal to crusher / yard / bunkers [The complete coal journey, concept: the-complete-coal-journey]

Visible labels: ⬇⬇⬇; SUDDEN SURGE — massive coal rush. Context: What is a Track Hopper? / Track_Hopper_iCard_Microlearning.html. - Diagram under: What is a Track Hopper?. Caption: Rail wagon with open bottom doors discharging coal by gravity into underground hopper. Visible labels: COAL WAGON; bottom doors open; ⬇⬇⬇; coal accumulating; Track Hopper Pit (underground). Context: Track Hopper – iCard Microlearning / Track_Hopper_iCard_Microlearning.html.
